Overview

The Production Department
transforms raw materials into finished goods through disciplined planning, scheduling, execution, and quality control. The team focuses on efficiency, cost management, on‑time delivery, and consistent product quality.

Role Summary

The Electrical Engineering Technician/Production Technician
supports the testing, troubleshooting, calibration, verification, and validation of newly manufactured electronic products and subassemblies. This role uses specialized electronic test and calibration equipment to diagnose circuit issues, inspect PCBs, validate product functionality, and accurately document results. The technician also maintains lab equipment, analyzes product failures, and collaborates with Engineering and Production to drive continuous improvement.

Entry‑level candidates with strong technical aptitude and a desire to grow in electronics are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Electronic Testing
— Perform troubleshooting, circuit testing, and calibrations on newly built units using general and specialized test equipment.
PCB Inspection
— Conduct incoming testing on printed circuit boards.
Lab Equipment Maintenance
— Maintain, repair, and refine test equipment to ensure reliability.
Product Verification
— Execute verification and validation testing for new products and subassemblies.
Standard Processes
— Follow established inspection, test, troubleshooting, calibration, and measurement procedures.
Documentation
— Complete and maintain accurate records of inspections, tests, repairs, and calibrations.
Failure Analysis
— Monitor customer repairs, identify common failure mechanisms, and communicate findings to Engineering and management.
Perform additional duties as assigned.

Technical Certificate or Associate Degree in Electrical/Electronics Technology, or equivalent military electronics technician training.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About The Role

We’re hiring an IT Systems Engineer to help build, secure, and improve the systems our employees rely on every day, with a particular focus on identity and access management (IAM) and mobile device management (MDM).

You’ll share ownership with our IT and Security engineers to improve how we manage identities, application access, and devices. This is a hands-on role that combines technical configuration, security judgment, and automation. We’re looking for someone who uses AI effectively to troubleshoot, build, and improve IT workflows. Experience managing IT systems as code using Terraform is a strong plus.

This role requires in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday from one of our offices (SF, NY, or ATX). For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do

Configure and improve Okta, including application integrations, single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), groups, access policies, and automated provisioning.
Build reliable onboarding, role-change, and offboarding workflows that keep employee access appropriate and up to date.
Configure and maintain MDM solutions, including device enrollment, configuration profiles, software deployment, patching, encryption, and compliance controls.
Partner with Security to define and implement least-privilege access, device security standards, access reviews, and device-based access policies.
Design and maintain scripts, API integrations, and automation across Okta, MDM, Google Workspace, Slack, and IT service management systems.
Help expand management of IT systems through code, including opportunities to use Terraform for Okta configuration and other supported resources.
Use AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, and workflow improvements while validating outputs and protecting company data.
Serve as an escalation point for complex identity, device, and systems issues; address root causes and prevent recurring problems.
Support AWS identity and access configurations as part of the broader IT environment.
Maintain clear documentation for configurations, access policies, integrations, and operational procedures.
Identify opportunities to simplify the IT environment, reduce technical debt, and improve SaaS lifecycle processes.

About You

Strong hands-on IT systems engineering experience, with deep expertise in either IAM or MDM and solid working knowledge of the other.
Experience administering Okta and integrating applications using technologies such as SAML, OIDC, and SCIM.
Experience configuring and operating an MDM platform such as Jamf, Kandji/Iru, Intune, or an equivalent.
Strong understanding of security principles, including least privilege, authentication and authorization, endpoint hardening, and secure handling of credentials and company data.
Proficiency with scripting languages such as Python or Bash, APIs, and workflow automation tools.
Demonstrated experience using AI to solve technical problems and improve IT operations, with the judgment to review generated code and validate proposed changes.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to follow problems across identity, devices, applications, and integrations.
Comfortable sharing ownership, collaborating with Security and other teams, and explaining technical decisions clearly.
Able to take projects from identifying a problem through implementation, documentation, and ongoing maintenance.

A Strong Plus

Experience using Terraform to manage Okta or other IT systems as code, including version-controlled configurations, code review, repeatable deployments, and configuration drift management.

Success in This Role Looks Like

More reliable identity lifecycle workflows, with timely provisioning, access changes, and deprovisioning.
Better device enrollment, patching, and compliance through consistent MDM configurations and automation.
Clearer access policies and repeatable access reviews developed in partnership with Security.
Less manual work through maintainable automation and effective use of AI.
More consistent, reviewable system configurations through expanded use of code where appropriate.
Fewer recurring identity and device issues through root-cause fixes.
Reliable documentation that helps the team operate, troubleshoot, and improve shared systems.

Benefits

Competitive salary and meaningful equity
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
Generous paid time off and parental leave
Professional development stipend
Daily lunch and commuter benefits (SF office)

Compensation & Benefits:

Competitive compensation package, including equity.
Inclusive Healthcare Package.
Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
Flexible Time Off.
We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $180,000.00 - $288,000.00. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

Privacy: Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data.

This position is intended for an experienced engineer with approximately 10 years of relevant technical experience who can work across cryptographic systems, network engineering, systems engineering, and security architecture. The role will support engineering analysis, technical integration, migration planning, solution assessment, and implementation activities associated with enterprise cryptographic modernization.

Support engineering and integration of cryptographic technologies across enterprise and mission systems.
Analyze existing cryptographic implementations, dependencies, protocols, and infrastructure to support modernization and migration activities.
Support implementation and integration of encryption technologies across network, system, cloud, and application environments.
Assist with cryptographic inventory and discovery efforts, including identification of algorithms, protocols, certificates, key dependencies, and affected systems.
Support post-quantum cryptography migration activities and implementation of emerging NIST and Department guidance.
Evaluate cryptographic products, architectures, and technical solutions for interoperability, security, scalability, and operational suitability.
Support testing, validation, troubleshooting, and technical assessment of cryptographic implementations.
Work with network and systems engineering teams to integrate cryptographic capabilities into existing architectures.
Develop technical documentation, engineering recommendations, implementation guidance, and briefing materials for technical and senior stakeholders.

This position is designed to be flexible, with responsibilities evolving to meet business needs and enable individual growth.

Requirements

Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility
Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a closely related technical discipline.
Minimum of 10 years of relevant engineering experience supporting systems, networks, cybersecurity, cryptography, or related technical environments.
Demonstrated experience with cryptographic technologies, encryption systems, or secure communications.
Experience integrating security or cryptographic capabilities into operational systems or network environments.
Strong understanding of network and security architecture concepts, including protocols, routing, segmentation, secure communications, and system dependencies.
Familiarity with technologies such as PKI, TLS, IPsec, MACsec, VPN technologies, certificates, key management, or hardware/software encryption solutions.
Working knowledge of classical cryptography and emerging post-quantum cryptography
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work with engineering, cybersecurity, program, and Government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting DoD, Federal Government, intelligence, or other high-assurance environments.
Hands-on network engineering experience.
Experience with cryptographic modernization, crypto-agility, or migration of legacy cryptographic technologies.
Experience with cryptographic inventory, discovery, or dependency mapping.
Experience with cloud, enterprise networking, embedded systems, or high-assurance communications environments.
Familiarity with FIPS-validated cryptographic products or modules.
Relevant technical certifications such as CISSP, CCNP/CCIE, Security+, or equivalent engineering/security credentials.

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

We’re hiring an IT Systems Engineer to help build, secure, and improve the systems our employees rely on every day, with a particular focus on identity and access management (IAM) and mobile device management (MDM).

You’ll share ownership with our IT and Security engineers to improve how we manage identities, application access, and devices. Use AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, and workflow improvements while validating outputs and protecting company data.
Serve as an escalation point for complex identity, device, and systems issues; address root causes and prevent recurring problems.
Support AWS identity and access configurations as part of the broader IT environment.
Maintain clear documentation for configurations, access policies, integrations, and operational procedures.
Identify opportunities to simplify the IT environment, reduce technical debt, and improve SaaS lifecycle processes.

Strong hands-on IT systems engineering experience, with deep expertise in either IAM or MDM and solid working knowledge of the other.
Experience administering Okta and integrating applications using technologies such as SAML, OIDC, and SCIM.
Experience configuring and operating an MDM platform such as Jamf, Kandji/Iru, Intune, or an equivalent.
Strong understanding of security principles, including least privilege, authentication and authorization, endpoint hardening, and secure handling of credentials and company data.
Proficiency with scripting languages such as Python or Bash, APIs, and workflow automation tools.
Demonstrated experience using AI to solve technical problems and improve IT operations, with the judgment to review generated code and validate proposed changes.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to follow problems across identity, devices, applications, and integrations.
Comfortable sharing ownership, collaborating with Security and other teams, and explaining technical decisions clearly.
Able to take projects from identifying a problem through implementation, documentation, and ongoing maintenance.

A Strong Plus

Experience using Terraform to manage Okta or other IT systems as code, including version-controlled configurations, code review, repeatable deployments, and configuration drift management.

Success in This Role Looks Like

More reliable identity lifecycle workflows, with timely provisioning, access changes, and deprovisioning.
Better device enrollment, patching, and compliance through consistent MDM configurations and automation.
Clearer access policies and repeatable access reviews developed in partnership with Security.
Less manual work through maintainable automation and effective use of AI.
More consistent, reviewable system configurations through expanded use of code where appropriate.
Fewer recurring identity and device issues through root-cause fixes.
Reliable documentation that helps the team operate, troubleshoot, and improve shared systems.

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
Generous paid time off and parental leave
Professional development stipend
Daily lunch and commuter benefits (SF office)

Competitive compensation package, including equity.

Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
Flexible Time Off.
